title: Please add the ability to customize and delete workout types
body: I do not use an Apple Watch and only use the Fitness app on my iPhone. It is a very poor user experience that I cannot delete or hide workout types (like hiking or cycling) that I never use from the workout list. Apple Watch users have the option to swipe and delete, but iPhone-only users are forced to see an cluttered list. Please add the ability to customize and delete workout types directly in the iPhone Fitness app, or allow better integration with alternative apps like Google Fit.
